name: real-multidataset-mini
description: Offline normalized mini-suite spanning Qasper, HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, and ASQA-style evidence QA tasks for EGRI benchmark scale-up tests. The checked-in records are small curated fixtures shaped to the public dataset schemas; full official dataset downloads should be resolved separately for paper-scale runs.

metadata.curation_note: Tiny offline fixture for deterministic CI only; use the manifest/catalog contract to materialize larger official subsets for paper tables.
metadata.intended_use: benchmark harness integration, not final reported EMNLP score
